verdict.rationale: Lindy's security docs state that customer data is "never used to train models," alongside encryption, SOC 2 Type II and GDPR/HIPAA compliance. Training is excluded by default, so the user's goal is met without any opt-out. The evidence is a single first-party sentence, with no detail on how this applies to the third-party model providers Lindy routes tasks to. Missing for 10: documented no-training or zero-retention terms with the underlying LLM providers, contractual or DPA-level detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
